summary: Complete initial independent audit of all 209 Chinese source units, 62 temporal or active-hint checks, and twelve people. Explicit late-Tang, Later Liang, Later Tang, and Later Zhou regnal-year records are supported at year precision. The Yimen two-decade chronology has an incorrect 907–923 interval, and Huang Chao is only a retrospective allusion in this chapter; both are retained as actionable source-specific findings. No source or canonical extraction was edited.
